title: Proposed fix contracts for an escalation park (#163)
description: Output of the optional `fix_contract_agent` on an adversarial_cycle escalation park: one proposed fix contract per open finding, for the human to approve, amend, or reject. Advisory — a contract never unparks a cycle; the operator's `resume --response` is the authority. Every property is required (native --output-schema strict mode).

finding_id.description: The open finding's id, exactly as given in the brief.

proposed_change.description: The specific change the next fix round should make — concrete enough to implement, scoped to the finding and its residual gap.

grounding.description: The approved PRD/plan clause(s) that bind the fix (cite section / FR ids), or 'no binding clause found'. For a decline, why.

acceptance_check.description: What the confirm pass should verify to call the finding resolved.

recommendation.description: fix_in_scope: fix it in this cycle; amend_upstream: the fix needs an approved artifact changed by a human first; decline: do not fix (reason in grounding).

summary.description: One or two sentences on the overall decision the human owes.
